map.吸收脉动与冲击的蓄能器选型。: Accumulator sizing for absorbing pulsation and shock.
map.填写「所需排油量 ΔV (L)」。: Enter the "required oil discharge volume ΔV (L)".
map.常取系统最低工作压力的 0.8~0.9，兼顾响应与可用油量。: Usually taken as 0.8-0.9 of the minimum system working pressure, balancing response against usable oil volume.
map.按保压时间与压力降定气囊容积。: Size the bladder volume from the holding time and the pressure drop.
map.校核最低工作压力是否满足执行器。: Check whether the minimum working pressure satisfies the actuator.
map.气囊蓄能器靠气体压缩储能，容积随压力按多变过程变化。: A bladder accumulator stores energy by gas compression, and its volume varies with pressure along a polytropic process.
map.液压缸推力速度行程计算: Hydraulic cylinder thrust, speed and stroke calculation
map.蓄能器容量计算 使用指南: How to use the accumulator capacity calculator
map.输入工作压力范围、气体预充压力与油液体积变化，按等温或绝热过程分别计算皮囊式蓄能: Enter the working pressure range, the gas precharge pressure and the oil volume change to compute the required volume of a bladder accumulator under isothermal or adiabatic conditions, for sizing in hydraulic systems that absorb shock, compensate leakage or act as an auxiliary power source.
map.预充压怎么定？: How is the precharge pressure set?
map.：充气 9 MPa、系统 12→21 MPa、需补油体积已知，按 p1V1^n=: : precharge 9 MPa, system rising 12 to 21 MPa and the oil volume to be added known, work back to the total volume from p1V1^n=p2V2^n (n≈1.4).
map.：最低压力要求提高，则所需总容积增大，过小会保压不足掉压。: : raising the minimum pressure requirement increases the needed total volume; too small a volume cannot hold the pressure and it drops.
